checks.scope: 15 synthetic probes; inherited worker and actual Electron preload
RN devtools shell quoting, two plist consumers, YAML
shared contracts and current Vite production frontend
actual Electron isolated ASAR; settings/backup/recovery/media repo, identity/privacy/contracts, IPC gate and installer/download fixtures
new Android/iOS Hermes bytecode; source maps match current code/contracts; one React per platform

notes: No clean npm ci reinstall in this batch; actual installed path/lock checks and both npm ls trees were used after repairing stale hidden metadata.
Initial plist regression expected an Object prototype; corrected to compare field sets/values for the existing null-prototype parser result.
Some npm fixAvailable=true findings propagate from a parent repair and do not mean a targeted leaf update can cross all existing parent constraints.
The bounded tar probe does not test a gzip bomb or prove exhaustive archive resource safety.
ASAR verification is an isolated fixture, not a complete signed Windows installer or native decoding acceptance.
Hermes/export/prebuild checks do not prove physical Android or native iOS execution. No native module or runtime upgrade was performed.
Electron 35 remains unsupported and affected; audit omit-dev=0 excludes a runtime that ships. Remaining mobile/packaging findings and all native release gates remain open.
No production data migration, publication, signing, update delivery or TLS deployment was performed.
